sources.title: Pairwise Negative Correlation for Uniform Spanning Subgraphs of the Complete Graph
sources.snippet: We study pairwise negative correlation for three families of uniform spanning-subgraph measures on the complete graph. In Part~I, we consider the uniform probability measure on connected spanning subgraphs and prove pairwise negative correlation for all sufficiently large complete graphs.
